fp = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')

python3 -c "
import sys, json, subprocess
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
fp = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('file_path', '')
if '/lib/' in fp and fp.endswith('.py') and not fp.endswith('__init__.py'):
    result = subprocess.run(['conda', 'run', '-n', 'prospectivity', 'ruff', 'check', fp], capture_output=True, text=True)
    if result.stdout:
        print(result.stdout)
" 2>/dev/null || true
